name: Industrial
text: A single $30M transaction lifted Q2. Q3 sales totalled $18.3M, while the trailing 12-month median price eased for the third consecutive quarter.

name: Office
note: A thin quarter. Relatively steady pricing.
text: Four sales totalled $4.4M, the lowest quarterly volume in the past year. The trailing 12-month median price has stayed near $210 per square foot since Q1.

name: Commercial / Retail
text: Q3 volume returned to levels seen in Q4 and Q1 after two deals above $7M lifted Q2. Asking rents remain the highest of the three non-residential segments.

name: Multi-family
text: Multi-family was the only segment with higher sales volume in Q3. All three buildings sold below the trailing 12-month median price per unit, bringing that median down slightly.
